description: Performance budgets for playwright-archaeologist. All times in milliseconds, memory in megabytes, sizes in kilobytes.

timeToProcess10Pages.notes: Simulated with mock browser (no real network). Measures orchestrator + frontier + collector overhead only.

timeToProcess100Pages.notes: With concurrency=3, mock browser. ~300ms per page budget including all collector passes.

timeToProcess500Pages.notes: With concurrency=3, mock browser. Context recycling every 50 pages.

enqueue10000Urls.notes: Includes URL normalization and dedup check per enqueue.

dequeue10000Urls.notes: Pure FIFO dequeue. Array.shift() has O(n) cost; may need circular buffer if exceeded.

has10000UrlCheck.notes: Per-lookup. Set.has() should be O(1) amortized.

urlNormalization.notes: Per URL. Called 25,000 times for a 500-page crawl with 50 links per page.

memoryAt100Urls.notes: RSS delta after loading 100 URLs into frontier.

memoryAt10000Urls.notes: RSS delta after loading 10,000 URLs. Average URL ~100 bytes + Set overhead.

memoryAt50000Urls.notes: Stress test. 50,000 normalized URLs in Set + FrontierEntry objects in array.

htmlGeneration100Pages.notes: Generates HTML string from in-memory data. No Mermaid rendering. No screenshots.

htmlGeneration500Pages.notes: Generates HTML string from in-memory data. Includes template literals and JSON serialization.

base64Encode100Thumbnails.notes: Encode 100 x 8KB JPEG thumbnails to base64 data URIs.

base64Encode500Thumbnails.notes: Encode 500 x 8KB JPEG thumbnails to base64 data URIs.

htmlFileSize100Pages.notes: Report HTML file size for 100-page crawl. Includes inlined CSS/JS, JSON data, base64 thumbnails.

htmlFileSize500Pages.notes: Report HTML file size for 500-page crawl. Must stay under 20MB for browser rendering.

peakRssDuringGeneration.notes: Peak RSS during report generation for 500-page dataset. String concatenation is the primary memory concern.

jsonSerializationTime.notes: JSON.stringify of the embedded report data object for a 500-page crawl.

sha256Hash100Screenshots.notes: SHA-256 of 100 x 200KB PNG buffers. Used for fast-path skip of unchanged screenshots.

pixelmatch10Screenshots.notes: pixelmatch comparison of 10 changed 1280x720 screenshots (~50ms each).

pixelmatch100Screenshots.notes: pixelmatch comparison of 100 changed 1280x720 screenshots. Worst case: all pages changed.

jsondiffpatch1000Endpoints.notes: jsondiffpatch of two API maps with 1000 endpoints each. Includes objectHash matching.

zipCreation100Pages.notes: Create .archaeologist ZIP bundle for 100-page crawl. PNGs stored uncompressed, JSON deflated.

zipExtraction100Pages.notes: Extract all entries from a 100-page .archaeologist ZIP bundle.

diffTotal100Pages.notes: Full diff pipeline: extract + hash + pixelmatch (10% changed) + jsondiffpatch + report.

diffTotal500Pages.notes: Full diff pipeline for 500-page bundles. Assumes 10% of screenshots actually changed.

size100Pages.notes: 100 pages x ~500KB PNG avg + JSON data. ~50MB target, ~150MB max.

size500Pages.notes: 500 pages x ~500KB PNG avg + JSON data. ~250MB target, ~750MB max.

rssMaxDuring500PageCrawl.notes: Peak RSS during 500-page crawl with concurrency=3. Includes 3 browser contexts. Warn at 1GB, pause at 1.5GB.

rssWarningThreshold.notes: Log warning when RSS exceeds this. Triggers reduced concurrency.

rssPauseThreshold.notes: Pause new context creation when RSS exceeds this. Wait for contexts to close.

apiGrouperWith5000Requests.notes: Group 5000 captured API requests by parameterized pattern. Includes URL parsing and regex matching.

routeTreeWith500Urls.notes: Build hierarchical route tree from 500 flat URLs.

flowGraphWith500Nodes.notes: Build navigation graph with 500 nodes and ~2000 edges. Includes cycle detection.
